prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. The ONLY named human protagonist is Kit. Zoe MUST NOT appear. Ignore every other child shown in reference sheets; unnamed adults may appear only when this scene explicitly requires them. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Follow the Park Map; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: World Discovery small enclosed park in daylight. Fixed plan: entrance gate at south/bottom; a straight path reaches one bench at a central fork; right branch passes one tall tree and reaches a kidney-shaped pond at northeast/top-right; left branch ends at a flowerbed. No roads.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One square paper park map with pictorial gate, bench, tree, pond and flowerbed connected by the exact established paths; One real brown bench; One real tall green tree; One curved pond
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Map and real park share the locked route; no pond in immediate foreground.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: World Discovery small enclosed park in daylight. Fixed plan: entrance gate at south/bottom; a straight path reaches one bench at a central fork; right branch passes one tall tree and reaches a kidney-shaped pond at northeast/top-right; left branch ends at a flowerbed. No roads. Kit stands just inside the entrance gate and opens the square park map; the path begins ahead of him. Exact state: Map and real park share the locked route; no pond in immediate foreground.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.
Map authority: make ONE clear top-down park plan as the location key and use the EXACT same plan for every displayed square map. South entrance at bottom center; path goes straight north to a central fork beside ONE brown bench. LEFT branch ends at flowerbed. RIGHT branch passes ONE tall tree, then ends at a kidney-shaped blue pond in top-right northeast. No other path, no looping path, no compass letters, no text, no extra bench/tree/pond. Kit is the ONLY human. Neutral simple boundary fence without signs.

visualReview.note: Checked map/park plan: south gate leads straight to central fork and bench; left branch ends at flowerbed; right branch passes one tall tree then reaches northeast kidney-shaped pond. Map views repeat same route, Kit only, no text labels.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; not physical classroom observation.
